status: What the ontology lacks to answer evals/dev/quote-to-order/proposed_items.json: one entry per ranked gap of the Quote-to-Order Map (map_rank 1-16, the map's order). Sources are named, never read here; Portal refs are at the repo pin d4d1bb247708 (verify/upstream-pins.json), not the map's unstated staging commit. 'source unknown' carries the question that would find one. OntologyProject refs on context/ paths are source records.

gaps.map_gap: Bring every cost input into the portal
gaps.name: QuoteCostInput (one cost input of a quote: kind, source record, as-of date, owner)
gaps.ontology_today: Quote and QuoteLine exist; a line's standard cost is a soft custom_fields value with unknown currency and denominator, and no cost input carries its source.

sources.relation: raw material price at quote: FM average cost, else supplier card, else zero
ready-to-quote census (blockers and warnings derived, not stored)

gaps.map_gap: Stop sending quotes to BC; send the order with its quote reference (ERP-D-014)
gaps.name: BC salesOrder -> Portal quote (the quote reference carried on the BC order)
gaps.ontology_today: Quote.converted_to links a Portal quote to a Portal sales order through custom_fields; SalesOrder.same_record_as reaches BC, but nothing links a BC order back to a quote, and BC salesQuotes are unbound.

sources.relation: won quote posted to BC as a salesQuotes document on acceptance

gaps.map_gap: Keep quoted tier prices as the customer's price agreement
gaps.name: CustomerPriceAgreement (won tier per SKU, currency, validity, source quote)
gaps.ontology_today: No price agreement type; asked volumes (app_quote_volume) are not served and nothing keeps a won tier after the first order.
gaps.open_question: Where are a customer's agreed per-SKU tier prices kept after a quote is won (BC price list, Sage price code or the quote workbook), and who updates them on a reorder?

gaps.map_gap: Hold supply agreements and carry terms to the order
gaps.name: SupplyAgreement (MSA or supply agreement: price period, deposit rule, payment terms, notice period)
gaps.ontology_today: No agreement type; customer and order carry no agreement reference.

sources.relation: Quote-to-Order Map, examples B and D (agreements override quote terms)

gaps.open_question: Where are signed MSAs and supply agreements stored, and who records their payment terms and deposit rules against the customer?

gaps.map_gap: Never quote a PLX-supplied component without a vendor price
gaps.name: Reader of vendor tier prices (app_supplier_product_tier) at quote time
gaps.ontology_today: RelPublicAppSupplierProductTier is generated as not served; no reader returns the vendor price a quote used.

sources.relation: a raw with no FM cost and no supplier card prices at zero

gaps.name: WorkbackSchedule (dated steps back from the ship date for one quote or project)
gaps.ontology_today: No workback type; ProjectTask is generated as not served and carries no quote link.

sources.relation: workbook manifest lists a WORKBACK SCHEDULE sheet in the G2 template

gaps.open_question: Who builds the workback schedule today, from which workbook sheet, and is it saved anywhere outside the quote workbook?

gaps.map_gap: Excel round-trip covers the whole quote with evidence
gaps.name: Quote workbook revision (name, item id, SHA-256) -> Portal quote revision
gaps.ontology_today: No link from a quote to the workbook it was priced in; the Portal round-trip covers the volume matrix only.

sources.relation: revision-stamped Excel round-trip of the volume matrix

gaps.map_gap: Agent turns emails into proposed portal updates
gaps.name: Reader of quote emails (sent date, sender role, attachment SHA-256) into proposed quote updates
gaps.ontology_today: No quote email reader; the pinned emails are hashed but their bodies are not assessed.

sources.relation: manifest of the 14 quote emails and 3 folder summaries

gaps.open_question: Which mailbox and folder hold the quote send and reply emails for each customer, and may an agent read them?

gaps.map_gap: Petra standard labour and overhead (ERP-D-022 vs OD-14)
gaps.name: Standard labour and overhead rate version used by one quote line
gaps.ontology_today: QuoteLine planned conversion per unit exists in the schema but is not a served column; no rate version is linked.
gaps.open_question: Which overhead standard is in force for quotes issued now, ERP-D-022 or OD-14, and who decides?

gaps.map_gap: Convert only the won tier, in the quote's currency
gaps.name: Won QuoteVolume -> SalesOrderLine
gaps.ontology_today: Quote.converted_to links the whole quote to one order; conversion copies every quote line.

gaps.map_gap: New customers and FG items reach BC (Sage code)
gaps.name: Customer and finished-good item -> BC customer and item (same record) at conversion
gaps.ontology_today: SalesOrder.same_record_as reaches BC; app_bc_entity_map is not served, so a customer or item never pushed to BC is not visible as missing.

sources.relation: BC entity types pushed by the outbox (customer, item, salesQuote, salesOrder)

gaps.name: LostQuote outcome (reason from a set list, competitor, note, date; or automatic expiry)
gaps.ontology_today: Quote has status REJECTED or EXPIRED and a free-text rejection_reason; no reason list, no expiry event.

gaps.map_gap: Payment terms, deposit % and incoterms as fields (OD-3)
gaps.name: Quote commercial terms as fields (payment term, deposit percentage, incoterm)
gaps.ontology_today: Quote.terms is free text; deposits received are app_order_prepayment rows, not served and tied to orders, not quotes.

gaps.name: QuoteRevision with its send event and approval (who, when, at what margin)
gaps.ontology_today: Quote has one status and no revision, sent-at or approver.
gaps.open_question: Who approves a quote before it is sent, and where is that approval recorded today?

gaps.map_gap: Quote on recorded assumptions and fix costing inputs
gaps.name: QuoteAssumption (input missing or assumed at quote time, its kind and owner): the slot for the quoting-with-incomplete-information case
gaps.ontology_today: The ready-to-quote census derives blockers and warnings at read time; no assumption is stored with the quote.

gaps.map_gap: Take quoting off FileMaker and Sage
gaps.name: Reader of FileMaker quote layouts and Sage order entry for these customers
gaps.ontology_today: The ontology states quotes exist only in the Portal (no FM, Sage or BC writer); Sage orders keyed by hand are not reachable.
gaps.open_question: Which FileMaker layouts and Sage screens are still used to price quotes or enter orders for Sahajan, G2 Beauty and Soapbox?
